build_inject_hyperparams_adam: build an optax optimizer with a piecewise linear schedule for beta_1 and constant beta_2 using inject_hyperparams
create_wrapped_schedule: create a stateful schedule wrapper that tracks step count and calls a stateless schedule function

review_inject_hyperparams_static_args: review inject_hyperparams static_args parameter to mark non-schedule callables as constant hyperparameters
